newsitem.title: ITALY: Albanian military pilots seek asylum in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Albanian military pilots seek asylum in Italy.

text.p: An Albanian military plane landed in southern Italy on Tuesday and its two pilots asked for political asylum, the Defence Ministry said.
It said in a statement the men landed a training "Mig-15" aircraft at a military air base in the southern town of Galatina, across the southern Adriatic from Albania, at 1122 GMT.
"The crew, consisting of two officers, is unhurt," the statement said. "Inquiries are underway."
A Defence Ministry spokesman named the two officers, who wore military uniforms, only as Major Elezi and Captain Dasci.
Albania has been in a state of chaos since the collapse in January of get-rich-quick pyramid saving schemes that left thousands penniless in Europe's poorest state.
Troops are now enforcing emergency rule to try to put down violence that has sent the southern part of the Balkan country reeling out of control.
The pilots were being questioned by police while the plane, which carried no weapons, was under surveillance on the runway.
A Foreign Ministry spokesman said no official request for asylum had yet been presented and had no further details.
